It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Thanh Hoang. I claim no copyright over the company's name, logo or content. No real bookings or payments are made, and flight data is simulated.
If you represent Thanh Hoang and would like anything changed or removed, please get in touch and I will act on it promptly.

homeAbout.label: About Thanh Hoang
homeAbout.title: Over ten years beside every journey.

meta.title: About — {brand}
meta.description: The history, vision, mission and core values of Thanh Hoang Travel, travelling alongside its customers since 2013.

hero.label: Thanh Hoang Travel · Since 2013
hero.title: Beside you on every journey.
hero.body: Thank you for trusting and travelling with us since 2013. In a spirit of care, good fortune and togetherness, Thanh Hoang is committed to service that is reliable, professional and wholehearted.
hero.company: Thanh Hoang Travel Trading and Development Co., Ltd.

history.label: Our history
history.quote: Every lasting journey begins with a steady first step.

milestones.title: Beginnings
milestones.body: Founded in 2013 to make booking a flight easy and transparent for Vietnamese travellers. From a small office in Ho Chi Minh City, Thanh Hoang quickly became an official agent of the country's major domestic airlines.

milestones.title: A technology breakthrough
milestones.body: Heavy investment in technology brought a smart online booking system with fares updated in real time. Market share leapt, and partnerships grew with many respected international airlines.

milestones.title: Fully digital
milestones.body: Ahead of travel 4.0, Thanh Hoang launched AGS99, a platform built for flight-ticket agents, along with visa support, hotel booking, travel insurance and 24/7 customer care.

milestones.title: Sustained momentum
milestones.body: More than a ticket seller, Thanh Hoang became a complete travel bridge connecting millions of passengers. The THcent system and agent incentives widened its network across the country.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: Vietnam's leading flight-ticket provider.
vision.body: Thanh Hoang keeps innovating with technology to make booking fast, safe and cost-effective. We don't just sell tickets: we make the start of every trip smooth and dependable — for business, family visits or holidays alike.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Connecting millions of travellers with the sky.
mission.body: With airlines at home and abroad, we offer the most convenient, accurate and fitting way to book — so every customer can reach quality flights at competitive, transparent fares, with wholehearted support.

items.name: Wholehearted support
items.body: Always beside you, ready to help.

finale.title: With gratitude, we wish you health and prosperity.

meta.title: Organization — {brand}
meta.description: How Thanh Hoang Travel is organised: its leadership, departments and network of collaborators.

hero.label: Our structure
hero.title: One team, one rhythm.
hero.body: Each department is its own cluster of skills, all turning around one centre: the traveller.

points.title: Service built around the customer
points.body: Our team puts customers' interests and experience first, handles the unexpected with flexibility, supports them 24/7 and keeps improving every transaction.

points.title: Fluent in technology, flexible in operation
points.body: Our people master modern booking platforms, work smoothly across departments and run efficiently even at the busiest times.

gd.role: Sets the strategy and is responsible for the company as a whole.

pgd.title: Deputy director
pgd.role: Coordinates the departments and oversees day-to-day operations.

kt1.role: Keeps the books and prepares financial reports.

kt2.title: Receivables accountant

it.role: Runs the booking system and its links to the airlines.

it1.title: IT team

kd.title: Head of sales

bk.role: Coordinates bookings for agents and groups.

bk1.title: Ticketing team
bk1.role: Issues tickets and handles after-sales requests.

board.label: Organization chart · Board
board.title: A steady structure.
board.body: A steady structure is the foundation for running well and growing for the long term. At the top, the Director, with a Deputy Director coordinating every department.

heads.label: Organization chart · Departments
heads.title: Five departments, five leads.
heads.body: Accounting, IT, Sales, HR and Booking — each led by its own head, reporting directly to the Deputy Director.

teams.title: Every role, one link in the chain.
teams.body: Under each head are the specialist roles, from receivables to the flight and ticket teams. Hover over a position to see what it does.

finale.title: Together, they keep Thanh Hoang growing.
